## Notes

- Columns are accumulated breakdown points for a vehicle type after the column shifts for its BAR (tables/breakdown-adjustments.json), hot weather (one column right) and sandstorm (one column right if at least half the points were earned in sandstorm sections); shifts are cumulative (chart note, SPI 21.3x)
- percent = share of that vehicle type that breaks down; dice are the sequential two-dice reading (SPI 11.4)
- Transcribed from the archive.org scan (jp2 101, printed sideways) and cross-checked against the 300 dpi community scan of the chart sheet (scan:discord:Shared Charts.pdf:p7): 0 of 54 cells differ. Clay Stone's errata-integrated Land rules PDF contains no chart sheet
